title: guide_demo_cta re-implements inline_cta's card scaffold instead of a shared CTA-card helper
evidence: inline_cta: ["mt-12 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-diffusion p-6 flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"] ... html.div([attribute.class("max-w-xl")], [ html.p( [attribute.class("font-headline text-lg font-semibold text-navy")], ... html.p([attribute.class("mt-1 text-slate font-body")] ... html.div([attribute.class("shrink-0")], [cta_button(button_label, href, "px-6 py-3")]) | guide_demo_cta: ["mt-4 bg-white rounded-xl border-2 border-navy/10 p-6 flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"] ... html.div([attribute.class("max-w-xl")], [ html.p( [attribute.class("font-headline text-base font-semibold text-navy")], ... html.p([attribute.class("mt-1 text-slate font-body")] ... html.div([attribute.class("shrink-0")], [ html.a( [ attribute.href("/demo"), attribute("data-testid", "guide-demo-cta"), attribute.class(demo_cta_base <> " px-6 py-3") ] | inline_cta doc: "Shared by the closing signup CTA on every content page and the checklist's PDF download, so a button is never stranded under left-aligned text with empty space to the right."
detail: Card scaffold (container, max-w-xl column, heading/subline classes, shrink-0 action column) is now maintained twice; the module extracted inline_cta precisely to avoid this.
recommended_fix: Extract a cta_card(card_class, heading_class, heading, body, action) helper in layout.gleam; inline_cta and guide_demo_cta become thin callers, so future card-token changes land once.
